data.description:
## Description

**What**: Extend `generate-semgrep-config.sh` so its DD-level coverage matches SC-2 in full — explicitly asserting the `golang -> p/golang` mapping and the convention-based/unknown -> mandatory-only fallback.

**Why**: Story 58bf-f9bb lists these mappings in its scope statement but does not have DDs that pin them down. Without DDs, completion-verifier cannot confirm SC-2's strict enumeration, and the script could silently regress on Go projects or treat unknown stacks unsafely.

**Scope**:
- IN: Go-stack fixture test, unknown-stack fixture test, full-matrix unit tests covering all four SC-2 stack mappings
- OUT: Rewriting script architecture; adding new languages beyond the four enumerated in SC-2

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, a Go-stack fixture (detect-stack.sh reports `golang`) passes through generate-semgrep-config.sh and produces a .semgrep.yml containing p/security-audit, p/owasp-top-ten, p/cwe-top-25, and p/golang; the generated file passes `semgrep --validate`
  ← Satisfies: sc-2  (sc-2: "generate-semgrep-config.sh produces a .semgrep.yml with mandatory rulesets plus stack-specific rulesets mapped from detect-stack.sh output — python-poetry, node-npm, golang, convention-based/unknown")
- When this story is complete, a convention-based / unknown-stack fixture (detect-stack.sh reports an unrecognized or convention-based stack) passes through generate-semgrep-config.sh and produces a .semgrep.yml containing exactly the three mandatory rulesets and no language pack; the generated file passes `semgrep --validate`
  ← Satisfies: sc-2  (sc-2: "convention-based/unknown -> mandatory rulesets only")
- When this story is complete, unit tests cover all four stack mappings from SC-2 (python-poetry, node-npm, golang, unknown) and run as part of the standard test suite
  ← Satisfies: sc-2
- When this story is complete, unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Testing] Use detect-stack.sh fixture mocks rather than real project layouts so tests are deterministic and fast
- [Design] If 58bf-f9bb's implementation already handles golang and unknown correctly, this story may reduce to test-only additions; flag during impl-plan if no script changes are needed
- [Compatibility] Do not change the mandatory-ruleset list; SC-2 fixes it

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a developer, my Semgrep config covers Go projects and falls back safely for unknown stacks
